attributes.name: Staunton Vhane
attributes.powers:
Before you act, discard the top card of your deck. Staunton Vhane deals 2 Combat damage to you, and the difficulty of the check to defeat is increased by 1d6+1.

If undefeated, a random character summons and encounters this adventure's servitor demon.
